commands.author: Pick-cat

target.title: fix(config): preserve empty env var values in config resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Fixes an issue where `resolveConfigValue` and `resolveConfigValueUncached` return the config key **name** as the resolved value when the corresponding environment variable is set to an empty string.

When a user explicitly sets `MY_API_KEY=""` in their environment, the `||` operator treats the empty string as falsy and falls through to the literal config key name. The literal string `"MY_API_KEY"` is then used as an API credential, producing a confusing "invalid API key" error from the provider instead of a clear "not configured" failure.

## Why This Change Was Made
Replaced `||` with `??` (nullish coalescing) so that an explicitly-set empty environment variable is preserved as the resolved value. The `??` operator only falls through when the value is `null` or `undefined`, not when it is an empty string. This matches the principle of least surprise: if a user sets an env var to empty, that is an explicit "no value" signal that should be honored rather than silently reinterpreted.

## User Impact
Users who accidentally leave an API key env var set to empty will now get a clear "API key not configured" error instead of a confusing "invalid API key" error from their provider. No impact on normal operation — env vars set to real values or left unset behave identically.

## Evidence

### After fix (all assertions pass)
```
=== After fix ===
  PASS: empty env returns empty string (not key name)
  PASS: empty env uncached returns empty string
  PASS: missing env falls back to literal (correct)
  PASS: set env returns actual value
ALL: 4 passed, 0 failed
```

### Negative control (pre-fix behavior reproduced)
```
=== NEGATIVE CONTROL ===
BUG: empty env returns key name "EMPTY_KEY" instead of ""
  resolveConfigValue => "EMPTY_KEY" ← BUG!
  resolveConfigValueUncached => "EMPTY_KEY" ← BUG!
```

### vitest (colocated test)
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

### Callers affected
- `auth-storage.ts:505` — API key resolution via `resolveConfigValue(cred.key)`
- `model-registry.ts:754` — provider API key via `resolveConfigValueUncached(providerApiKey)`
- `resolveConfigValueOrThrow` (L105) — delegates to `resolveConfigValueUncached` internally
